A.why: Force from a uniform electric field is constant and collinear with the field; with initial velocity parallel to the field the particle experiences acceleration along the same line, giving straight‑line motion.

B.why: A constant electric force perpendicular to the initial velocity produces uniform acceleration orthogonal to the motion, yielding a parabolic trajectory analogous to projectile motion.

C.why: Magnetic force is q v×B; if v is parallel to B the cross product is zero, so no magnetic force acts and the particle moves straight, not in a helix.

D.why: With velocity perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field the magnetic force provides the required centripetal force, resulting in circular motion in a plane normal to B.
